repo.description: The m0saic developer curriculum: minimal example templates, each exercising exactly one knob of the template-authoring surface. Clone it, load it, read it, fork it.

templates.title: Hello World
templates.description: The smallest correct template, wearing the brand: the pixel-M in a square cell over a greeting, typed props with deterministic defaults, and a validated m0 string. The repo's smoke render.

templates.title: Hot-Reload Canary
templates.description: Prove your edit loop: the fill comes from a module CONSTANT, so a rebuild + Refresh repos must change it — no app restart, no prop-bag tricks.

templates.title: Color Tiles
templates.description: Three equal columns, one makeColorTile each — the sources[]-to-tiles mapping, the lavfi color-tile convention, and document.backgroundColor over a wasted base layer.

templates.title: Aspect-Adaptive Card
templates.description: One template, every aspect: reads ctx.target and flips columns to rows on portrait. Size off ctx.target, never ctx.output — the rule that prevents the classic nested-render bug.

templates.title: GCD Collapse
templates.description: Two pixel-identical rows from the same weights: literal keeps 100 slots, the default optimized mode collapses to 4. Same look, fraction of the string.

templates.title: Ratio vs Absolute
templates.description: The same 1:2:1 spelled as a ratio split (recomposes anywhere) and as placeRects (exact pixels, baked to THIS canvas). Identical render, opposite promises.

templates.title: Overlay Stack
templates.description: 1{3[-,1{1},-]}: base, band on its overlay, badge on the band's overlay. Overlays restore their node's whole rect and paint after it.

templates.title: Lattice Gutters
templates.description: Base × fiber: a plain gutterless grid as the m0, pixel-exact gutters computed into per-cell placement insets by latticeCellInset. Exact at every canvas, zero DSL cost.

templates.title: Inset Recovery
templates.description: Exact pixels that survive nesting: placeInsetPieces keeps the string coarse (precision bounded at the lattice basis) while placement.inset recovers every chip byte-exact. The caption prints the precision floor placeRects would bake instead — the cost a parent inherits.

templates.title: PlaceRect Dock
templates.description: One pixel-exact rect docked bottom-right via placeRect — margins are null tiles, nothing quantizes into your rect. Head-only: the string bakes THIS canvas.

templates.title: Mask in a Cell
templates.description: A diamond as a masked color tile in a plain ratio cell. Mask bounds scale onto the cell per axis — match their aspect or the shape silently smears.

templates.title: Quantization: Three Cures
templates.description: The capstone: one 12×3 gridded design through four spellings — naive ratio gutters that wobble N/N+1 px, then inset recovery, snapGrid, and placeRects. Flip the Method enum, watch the lines even out, read the receipts.

templates.title: Typed Props Tour
templates.description: One prop of each scalar type — string, number, boolean, enum — each visibly driving the render, receipts on the caption. The schema picks the controls; render() is the gate.

templates.title: Seeded Shuffle
templates.description: Randomness the m0saic way: a REQUIRED seed through mulberry32 — identical props render byte-identical documents, and the caption prints the deal.

templates.title: Color Props
templates.description: Color props declare themselves: isColor + colorPicker gives the scalar a swatch and the string[] the color-list control. Panel beside palette column.

templates.title: JSON Data Prop
templates.description: Structured data through one type:"json" prop — collect-ALL validation with remedies, then the records become geometry: one proportional bar per row.

templates.title: Control Gallery
templates.description: The meta surface, one knob per affordance: placeholder, flavor:"url", bounded+stepped numbers, enum select, ui.label. The real demo is the sidebar.

templates.title: Error Mosaic
templates.description: Failing on-canvas, usefully: collect EVERY problem with a remedy and return makeErrorMosaic — a renderable report card instead of a dead preview.

templates.title: Text, Three Ways
templates.description: The same word through all three text pipelines, side by side: drawtext (ffmpeg, expr-capable, host fonts), the svg rasterizer (bundled font baked to geometry), and mask-carved glyphs (text as a mask any source can wear).

packs.title: Basics
packs.description: Hello world, the hot-reload loop, color tiles, and sizing off ctx.target — the smallest possible templates that still do everything right.

packs.title: Geometry
packs.description: The m0 geometry contract as runnable lessons: quantization you can predict, GCD collapse, ratio vs absolute, passthrough donation, overlays, lattice gutters (both spellings), inset recovery, placeRect, and masks as fiber.

packs.title: Props
packs.description: The typed props surface as runnable lessons: one knob of every scalar type, seeded determinism, self-declaring color controls, structured json data, the meta/control affordances, and failing usefully with makeErrorMosaic.

packs.title: Text
packs.description: Text that renders right: the three glyph pipelines side by side (drawtext, svg rasterizer, mask-carved), then the per-technique deep dives — fitting, expressions, and carved type.
